narrative: On the plot. A different plot on the same peg. The title and the hour. No name of a part beside his. On the plot. A paper read at the door and not taken down. One title.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Played the afternoon, and stayed on this bank.

entities.name: Richard the Third
entities.context: Shown on plot in The other gown, and Faustus
